# Agent Loom — Visual AI Agent Workflow Builder
> Web-based visual canvas for designing, chaining, simulating, and executing multi-agent LLM pipelines in real time.

## Overview
Agent Loom is a open-source visual workflow environment created by Zoth Studio Team (nullai.tech). Built with React 19, TypeScript, React Flow (@xyflow/react), Tailwind CSS, and Zustand, Agent Loom enables developers and AI researchers to construct node-based multi-agent graphs.

## Key Capabilities
- Visual Node-Based Graph Canvas: Drag, drop, connect, and configure autonomous AI agents.
- Orchestrators & Specialist Leaf Agents: Supports hierarchical orchestration with master agents delegating tasks to specialized workers.
- Flexible Provider & Model Selection: Supports OpenRouter, OpenAI (GPT-4o, o3/o4), Anthropic (Claude Opus 4, Sonnet 4), Google Gemini 2.5, Llama 3.3, and DeepSeek R1.
- Custom Toolsets & Skill Attachments: Equip agents with tools (`browser`, `terminal`, `file`, `web`, `search`, `code_exec`, `delegate`) and technical skills (`frontend-design`, `devops`, `security`, `data-science`, `mlops`).
- Execution Loops & Fallbacks: Configure loop modes (`once`, `loop`, `loop-on-error`, `loop-max`) with configurable retry limits and timeouts.
- Real-Time Simulated Runner & Offline Engine: Live execution engine with step-by-step progress logging, streaming simulated outputs, sound synthesis, and state visualization without requiring external API keys.
- Preset Templates & Pipeline Import/Export: Load pre-built agent graphs (Full Stack Web Builder, AI Code Reviewer, Security Auditor, Data Science & MLOps Pipeline) or export/import workflow JSON definitions.
